question_en: What was agreed on PDCCH blind decoding? (PDCCH decisions)
original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'PDCCH' AND a.content CONTAINS 'blind' RETURN a.resolutionId, m.meetingNumber, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, a.resolutionId LIMIT 10
